messages:
anita: Heads-up — saw a KV-cache cold-start spike hitting prod lane-3 at ~20:04 UTC. SmallBatchSplitter produced a large fraction of 1-2 token microbatches which apparently triggered the kernel fallback path. 95p token latency jumped and customer-facing SLOs tripped. :eyes:

sam: Which route / customer? can you paste the dashboard snapshot or the prom queries you ran?

anita: Route: /chat/generate (customer_id=acme). Grafana link: https://grafana.internal/r/xyz (snapshot attached). Quick numbers: 95p token-latency went from ~90ms -> ~320ms for batches sized 1. Batch-size histogram during the window: ~70% size=1, 22% size=2, remainder >4. KV cache hit rate dropped from ~98% -> ~65% concurrently.

-- prom snippets I ran: 
```
sum by(batch_size) (rate(runtime_batcher_batches_total[1m]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, batch_size))
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[1m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[1m]))
```

perf-bot: ALERT: batch_size_mode=1 detected, kernel_fallback_count=47 (5m), kv_miss_spike=+32% vs baseline. Ticket auto-created: PERF-2134.

mike: Did we deploy the small-batch splitter tweak yesterday? I remember a PR that set max_delay from 5ms -> 2ms for latency-critical lanes. Could explain the higher microbatch churn.

laura: I briefly rolled back that splitter change on a canary but the cold-start spike persisted on lane-3. My suspicion: the kernel-selector heuristic is now more aggressive in picking the lightweight kernel, but when KV miss rate increases it trips the fallback (FP32 warm path) which has non-negligible setup time. We need to correlate per-worker restarts / kernel-initialization logs.

sam: Agreed. Action plan: 1) push hotfix to relax SmallBatchSplitter max_delay for prod lanes for next 30m, 2) add a per-route KV warmup/prefetch (best-effort) for long-lived chat sessions, 3) instrument a new label `kernel_decision` on runtime spans and surface it in dashboards (kernel_choice by batch_size, per-route). Also add panel for kv_hit_rate by route and by worker.

anita: I'll open a short issue + hotfix PR now, include the flamegraph and a short perf recorder trace in the PR description. Will also add the new dashboard panels as proposed. If anyone can triage the PERF-2134 alerts while I work the PR that'd be great.

sam: Thanks — please tag me on the PR. If this reproduces we should consider a short-term circuit: if batch_size_mode==1 && kv_hit_rate<80% then force batching delay to 8ms to let KV warmups amortize.

mike: +1 to the circuit. Also add an automated test that simulates KV miss spikes and verifies kernel selector doesn't fallback too frequently.

laura: noted, I'll follow up with a per-worker instrumentation checklist (logs/traces/metrics) and a tiny stress test harness.

perf-bot: PERF-2134 updated: status=investigating, assignees=[anita, laura], severity=high.
